admissionReview.sourceDistinctions: Rechecked all 32 source/state/action distinctions against unchanged frozen C recordings for all 41 v17 cases and the one currently unresolved older v16 tin-opener case. Earlier object-detection mismatch is now resolved; retaining its historical comparison does not omit a current unresolved case. The aggravation continuation now exposes a weapon-wield refusal at step 51, still distinct from v18 monster-to-hero sleep, slime, fire and drain attack arms. Current prior input identities are unchanged. Matching target misses and two unresolved v18 causes remain included and uncounted; thirteen earlier overlap/prefix probes remain excluded. Failed AD_ENCH, AD_SLEE and AD_PLYS gates do not prove secondary effects. Older drain-life routes include spell-ray floor objects, rather than only the historical scroll/item labels in the packet; their object target and call history differ from v18 attacks on the hero. No current causal overlap found. Measurements in the preparation packet retain comparison base c279bd55; this review does not relabel them as current JS results.
